title: Shadow Atlas Configuration
description: Per-category shadow rendering settings for the unified ShadowAtlas system

categories.description: Named shadow categories, each with independent rendering settings

pcfSpread.description: PCF filter radius in texels. 0 = hard pixel edges, 1-2 = crisp, 4+ = soft diffuse.

shadowBias.description: Depth bias to prevent shadow acne (self-shadowing artifacts)

global.description: Global settings shared across all categories

shadowRadius.description: Camera-centered shadow coverage radius in meters

maxShadowDist.description: Max distance from camera before shadows fade out
